notes: Critical Speed Yaw now uses the conventional additive superelevation adjustment by default: `f_adjusted = f_level + e`.
Superelevation can be entered as percent, degrees, or rise/run decimal; degree input is converted with `e = tan(theta)`.
The prior banked-plane force-balance calculation remains available as an explicitly selected alternate method.
Legacy saved cases without the new method and unit fields retain their prior interpretation.
Automated validation completed with 819 passing tests. The packaged hands-on pre-deployment test was waived for this beta-tester rollout.
This release-only artifact must be uploaded to the public release-only repository, not the private source repository.
Do not upload source archives, source trees, CVS/NHTSA downloaded datasets, private keys, or local caches.
